The plugin test suite had one failure after the build passed. I’ll inspect the monitor’s failure details, fix the cause, rerun the checks that did not complete, then review and commit the approved changes in both repositories.

The monitor confirms there were no stage diagnostics, so I’m narrowing the retained test log to the single failed assertion. The main repository currently has only the planned docs change; I’m also checking the linked plugin checkout’s instructions and status before touching it.

The failing test reproduces on its own. It exposed a timezone bug in date-only schedule parsing: JavaScript treats `"2026-10-29"` as UTC, which becomes the prior local day in New York, so two future tasks slip into the walk. I’m correcting date-only strings to use local calendar dates, then I’ll rerun the full plugin checks and sync.
